confidence_notes: Overall low confidence. Restaurant anchors use crowd-sourced aggregator figures (combien-coute.net citing Numbeo, updated July 2026) converted from LKR at an assumed rate of about 305 LKR per USD, so they are approximate. Beer and cocktail anchors rely on 2024-era resort menus and undated Colombo bar surveys adjusted down for Kandy. Wine_glass has no direct price source and is inferred from beer at roughly 2x. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates without checking live listings; they allow for a possible demand uplift in late July from the Kandy Esala Perahera festival. Prices exclude service charge and taxes, which are often added in Sri Lanka. FX: the 0.6947 USD_PER_AUD value for 2026-10-16 comes from a search-result summary attributed to rba.gov.au, which I did not open. Verify it against the official RBA daily exchange-rate table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city outside Sri Lanka was used. The basis is the national cost-of-living level (GlobalCostData about 25 and Wise about 23 on a New York City = 100 scale), with Colombo and Kandy restaurant and café price points from aggregator data, adjusted for Kandy being cheaper than Colombo for cappuccino and similar items.
